<thought>We need the precursors for the product SMILES 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1' using template 1914394. The template breaks the C‑CH2Cl bond, giving dichloromethane (ClCH2Cl) and the same scaffold without the CH2Cl substituent. The resulting precursor SMILES are 'ClCCl' and the scaffold with a hydrogen on the aromatic carbon: 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(C)cc2)C1'. This is the only possible combination.</thought>
<final_answer>[["ClCCl", "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(C)cc2)C1"]]</final_answer>
